topics.topic: The World’s Wife — Carol Ann Duffy (poetry, this term)
topics.notes: School Y12 texts slide; starred “this term”; school says they start with Duffy for SL/HL. Term overview also lists 5 weeks under Politics, Power & Justice. SL pathway. Originally written in English — relevant later for the official IO “language studied” slot, but no IO pairing is invented here.

topics.topic: Persepolis — Marjane Satrapi (graphic novel, this term)
topics.notes: School Y12 texts slide, starred “this term.” Term overview: 4 weeks under Beliefs, Values & Education, plus a brief ABC intro on authorial choices / graphic-novel features. Originally written in French (a possible later IO translation work — not assigned here). This is a literary work on the Literature course, not a “non-literary text.”

topics.topic: Like Water For Chocolate — Laura Esquivel (novel, this term)
topics.notes: School Y12 texts slide, starred “this term.” Missing from the term-overview slide — do not drop it for that reason; it remains on the Y12 list. Originally written in Spanish (a possible later IO translation work — not assigned here).

topics.topic: The Things They Carried — Tim O’Brien (novel)
topics.notes: School Y12 texts slide; not starred as this term. Missing from the term-overview slide. Keep as a confirmed Y12 SL text, not as a this-term unit, until the school says when it is taught.

topics.topic: Assessment SL — Paper 1 guided literary analysis (35%)
topics.notes: Official Literature brief: one unseen literary passage from a choice of two forms, 1 hr 15 min, 35%. School also requires a minimum of two Paper 1 assessments this term.

topics.topic: Assessment SL — Paper 2 comparative essay (35%)
topics.notes: Official Literature brief: one comparative essay on two literary works studied, from a choice of four questions, 1 hr 45 min, 35%. Works used in the IO must not be reused here.

topics.topic: Assessment SL — Individual Oral (30%): one work in English and one work in translation on a common global issue
topics.notes: Official Literature brief wording, not the school’s Lang Lit wording. SL 30%. School and IB-school handbooks: 10 minutes prepared + 5 minutes of questions. Do not describe this as a literary + non-literary oral.

topics.topic: This term — mini IA oral practice (5 minutes) on a literary work
topics.notes: School “outcomes by the end of this term” slide. School practice, not an official IB component. Useful as a Week-tab skill row. Official IO is two works, 10 + 5 minutes.

topics.topic: This term — full IA oral practice (10 minutes) on a literary work
topics.notes: School term-outcomes slide. School practice toward the official IO; still described by the school as one literary work, so it is not yet the official two-work task.
